text: Added separate multivar-ir JVM/Scala.js module and build/docs wiring. Implemented versioned 0.1 semantic model and strict portable JSON codec for spaces, primal/dual coordinates, operators, form roles/positivity/certificates, scale gauges, measures, centering, singularity, missingness, row relationships/support/marginals, objectives, provenance, and unsafe assumptions. Added canonical SHA-256 inline payloads and hashed external references, semantic lowering from multivar, stable cross-binding rejection categories, schema/evolution policy, JSON Schema, and published conformance corpus. Verified 11 JVM and 9 Scala.js tests; all JSON artifacts parse and valid fixture passes JSON Schema.
